doc.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Southern, Berklee and becoming a jazz player
title: Learning his first jazz solos in high school
summary: He played in Batiste's band and learned a Parker solo on Tico Tico and Summertime from Bird with Strings.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Now when you were at Southern, were you already getting into jazz at that point?

Yeah. I was doing…. I was playing in Bat’s band. I mean I was the king of the pentatonic scale…. So I learned two solos in high school. I learned a Charlie Parker solo, “Tico Tico” from a record called Fiesta. And then I learned a….pst, pst,. Can you believe that? I can’t remember. “Summertime!”
Why did you choose to learn those?
They were nice. Just something, you know, something to do.
Bird with Strings. Easy, not a bunch of notes, not real fast….
